facts.fact: Adverge's benchmark article analyzes more than $5M in Meta ad spend from accounts it actively manages (vendor's own figure).
facts.quote: every number below comes from real accounts we actively manage — spanning **$5M+ in Meta ad spend** across ecommerce and local-service brands.

facts.fact: Adverge's figures are aggregated and anonymized at the account level, in USD, across active accounts from 2023 to 2026.
facts.quote: figures are aggregated and anonymized at the account level, in USD, across active accounts (2023–2026).

facts.fact: Adverge reports its best-in-class ecommerce ROAS as 4.7× (Golferos Anonimos account).
Adverge's lowest CPC across accounts it runs is $0.32, achieved in a strong visual niche.
facts.quote: **Lowest CPC we run:** $0.32 in a strong visual niche

facts.fact: Adverge's top CTR is 2.7%, which it describes as roughly triple the common ecommerce average.
facts.quote: **Top CTR:** 2.7% — roughly triple the common ecommerce average

facts.fact: Adverge's largest single program (Bayou Braces) delivered 43M+ impressions and reached 2.1M people.
facts.quote: **Largest single program:** 43M+ impressions and 2.1M people reached (Bayou Braces)

facts.fact: Adverge reports an ecommerce/DTC CTR range of 2.3–2.7% across its managed accounts.
Adverge reports an ecommerce/DTC CPC range of $0.30–$1.60 across its managed accounts.
Adverge reports an ecommerce/DTC CPM range of $9–$43 across its managed accounts.
Adverge states that mature, well-run ecommerce accounts hit ROAS of 4× or more.
facts.quote: mature, well-run accounts hit 4×+; new or unoptimized accounts frequently sit below 1× until the offer and creative are fixed.

facts.fact: Adverge states that new or unoptimized ecommerce accounts frequently sit below 1× ROAS until the offer and creative are fixed.
facts.quote: new or unoptimized accounts frequently sit below 1× until the offer and creative are fixed.

facts.fact: Adverge reports a local lead-gen CTR range of 0.7–1.2% across its managed accounts.
Adverge reports a local lead-gen CPC range of $1.00–$2.30 across its managed accounts.
Adverge reports a local lead-gen CPM range of $10–$27 across its managed accounts.
Adverge cites a typical orthodontic/dental/med spa case value of $3,000–$7,000+ for judging local lead-gen cost per case.
facts.quote: against a $3,000–$7,000+ case value, which keeps even a higher CPC comfortably profitable.

facts.fact: Adverge's FAQ describes a 3× ROAS as solid and 4×+ as excellent for ecommerce Facebook ads.
facts.quote: For ecommerce, 3× is solid and 4×+ is excellent; our best account runs 4.7×.

facts.fact: The article cites a commonly referenced ecommerce average CTR of about 1% from third-party sources, which Adverge compares its 2.3–2.7% range against.
facts.quote: well above the ~1% often cited as the ecommerce average.

facts.fact: Adverge offers a free audit that benchmarks a prospect's CPC, CTR, CPM and cost per result, delivered within 48 hours.
facts.quote: Get a free 48-hour audit — we benchmark your CPC, CTR, CPM and cost per result against this data and show you the gaps.
